description: This Java class implements the 'ModifyThingDefinitionStrategy' which handles the modification of 'ThingDefinition' entities within the Eclipse Ditto project. It processes commands to modify or create 'ThingDefinition' objects, generating appropriate event responses.

classes.name: ModifyThingDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles commands to modify or create 'ThingDefinition' entities, producing appropriate event results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command logic to modify or create a 'ThingDefinition', returning the result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Generates a result indicating a modification of an existing 'ThingDefinition'.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Generates a result indicating the creation of a new 'ThingDefinition'.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the 'EntityTag' associated with the previous 'Thing' entity if present.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the 'EntityTag' for the new 'ThingDefinition' from the command.
